source.name: USGS Data Series 801
source.method: Cu, Ni, Zn, Li: ICP-AES; Co: ICP-MS. Near-total HCl/HNO3/HClO4/HF digestion. Units mg/kg. See USGS metadata for precision and methods.
source.useConstraints: Access constraints: none. Users determine suitability for their purpose. Attribute USGS and retain source qualifications.

source.name: USGS Copperwood Western Syncline drill-core geochemistry
source.license: CC0 1.0 Universal, as marked by the USGS release; retain attribution and source qualifications.
source.positionalAccuracy: WGS84 sample-site coordinates. USGS metadata reports no formal positional accuracy tests; borehole trajectories are not supplied.
source.depthInterpretation: Source reports interval depths from the surface in feet. Axis is not established as vertical. No vertical-depth or 3D trajectory reconstruction is made.
source.selection: Selected drill-core samples from a known copper deposit; not representative global exploration negatives or an independent test of the soil model.

source.name: USGS Slab2 — March 2018 archive
source.author: Gavin Hayes / U.S. Geological Survey
source.license: CC0 1.0 Universal; metadata use constraints: none
source.updateFrequency: None planned in this release metadata
source.depthConvention: Negated source depth grid z, following the supplied USGS query script; supplementary CSV depths retain their source sign. Units: km.
source.coordinates: Geographic longitude/latitude in degrees. Source grids use 0–360 longitude. A named horizontal/vertical datum is not declared in the supplied grid metadata.
source.uncertainty: Source depth uncertainty (PDF standard deviation, km); not a calibrated Baryon prediction interval or total uncertainty.
source.normalization: Every fifth index in both axes is retained for the grid preview (0.1 or 0.25 degrees according to actual grid spacing). All supplementary nodes are retained. Coordinates rounded to 6 decimals; grid attributes to 0.001 km/degrees. Missing cells remain absent; no interpolation or averaging.
metadataWarnings: README spacing differs from five actual grids.
The parent metadata lineage cites an apparently unrelated 2017 paper; the Slab2 publication is linked separately.
The archive README includes a placeholder DOI; the verified catalog DOI is retained.

structure.scope: Subducted slab geometry in 27 model regions. No global crustal composition, mineral inventory, borehole trajectory or ore-body model is inferred. External model ingestion is not new measured evidence or demonstrated Baryon model improvement.

trade.note: The monthly copper trade importer is implemented locally. Public redistribution rights for this commercial product are not established; values remain unpublished pending the applicable permission or license.

scope: Regional measured evidence, external Slab2 geometry, one historical shallow-soil experiment and a sourced copper-project scenario. Global subsurface prediction and recursive research-policy improvement remain in development.
